Industries

Catch the calls going to the shop down the road

A driver with a dead battery or a grinding brake doesn’t scroll — they call one of the first shops on the map and that’s the job. Every “mechanic near me” that ranks a competitor ahead of you is a tow-in you’ll never hear about, and a single rank number can’t show you where it’s slipping. Eagle Eye maps your rank across the whole radius drivers reach you from and names the shop winning the calls you’re losing, street by street.

See where you’re losing the job

  • Rank across your draw radius — set the grid to the distance drivers come from: square, circle, or drawn to your area.
  • A competitor map per rival — the shops taking the urgent searches on the roads you don’t own.
  • ATRP — one number for the stretches where you’re off the map entirely, so the gaps are measured, not guessed.
  • Instant alerts — hear it the moment you drop out of the top 20 on a route that feeds you work.

Start free with 10 scans and a free first scan of your own shop up to 21 × 21 — credits never expire, so a slow month is never wasted. Put it on a schedule or see the plans.

Three numbers, every scan

Three numbers a client remembers and a trend that proves your work paid off. Every scan rolls the whole grid into them — no spreadsheet, no hand-waving.

Questions, answered

How does Eagle Eye help an auto repair shop rank?

It maps your rank across the whole radius drivers reach you from for searches like “mechanic near me”, and names the shop winning the urgent calls you’re losing, street by street.

Can I set the scan to the area drivers come from?

Yes — set the grid radius to the real distance drivers travel and shape it as a square, circle, or a drawn area.

Will I know when I drop off the map on a key road?

Yes — set alerts and hear it the moment you fall out of the top 20 on a route that feeds you work.

Can I see which shops outrank me?

Eagle Eye draws a competitor map for every rival that outranks you — their rank at every point of the same grid — so you see exactly which competitor wins each block, not just that you place #5.

Is there a free scan to start?

A new organisation starts with 10 free scans, and your first scan of your own website is free at any size up to 21 × 21 — no card needed.
